name: SizeSync for WooCommerce
author: WooEver

sections.description:
SizeSync for WooCommerce is the easiest way to add professional size charts to your WooCommerce store. Reduce returns and increase customer confidence by showing accurate size guides on every product page.

Key Features

  • 40+ clothing categories — Men’s, Women’s, Footwear, Kids & Baby, Accessories
  • 8 international size systems — UK, USA, EU, Italy, France, Japan, Korea, China
  • Smart auto-detection — Automatically shows the right size guide based on product category
  • Manual assignment — Assign any size guide to any WooCommerce product category
  • Fully editable charts — Edit any cell, add/remove rows and columns from admin panel
  • Beautiful popup modal — Clean, responsive design works on all devices
  • Brand name display — Show your store name inside the size guide
  • Inline or popup mode — Choose how size guides appear on product pages
  • No coding required — Works out of the box

Supported Categories

Men’s Clothing: T-Shirt, Hoodie, Jacket, Formal Shirt, Polo, Shorts, Tank Top, Joggers, Jeans, Trousers, Suit, Swimwear, Underwear, Socks

Women’s Clothing: Dress, Top/Blouse, Skirt, Jeans, Leggings, Jumpsuit, Swimwear, Bra, Underwear, Coat, Socks

Footwear: Shoes (Men/Women/Kids), Boots (Men/Women), Heels, Sneakers

Kids & Baby: Kids Top, Kids Bottom, Kids Dress, Baby Clothing

Accessories: Hat/Cap, Gloves, Belt, Scarf

Size Systems

Each category has its own dedicated chart for: UK, USA, EU, Italy, France, Japan, Korea, China
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sizesync-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated
  4. Go to SizeSync in your WordPress admin sidebar
  5. Configure your brand name and default size system in General Settings
  6. Go to Assign to Categories and map your WooCommerce categories to size guides
  7. Size guides will automatically appear on product pages!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Can I edit the size charts?

Yes! Go to SizeSync → Size Charts, click any category, and edit any cell directly.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes, the popup modal is fully responsive.

How do I assign a size guide to a specific product category?

Go to SizeSync → Assign to Categories and select a size guide for each category.
